name: 🏙️ City Defense Tycoon
desc:
Welcome to City Defense Tycoon!

🦸 Unlock and power up cool heroes!
💸 Protect your city’s bank from waves of enemies!
🏙️ Build the city of your dreams!
⚔️ Raid your friends' cities for cash rewards!

Private servers are free!

💾All progress is autosaved so you can resume back at any time!💾
